definitions.explanation: A work schedule system where employees take turns working different time periods, typically covering a 24-hour operation.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}では{交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}が{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Shift work is standard at the factory.

examples.japanese: {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}で{夜勤|やきん}が{月|つき}に{何回|なんかい}かある。
examples.english: With shift work, I have night shifts several times a month.

examples.japanese: {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}は{体|からだ}への{負担|ふたん}が{大|おお}きいが、{医療|いりょう}や{製造業|せいぞうぎょう}では{欠|か}かせない{勤務形態|きんむけいたい}だ。
examples.english: Shift work takes a heavy toll on the body, but it's an indispensable work arrangement in healthcare and manufacturing.

notes:
A compound of {交替|こうたい} (alternation, taking turns) and {勤務|きんむ} (work, duty). Also written as {交代勤務|こうたいきんむ} with the variant kanji {交代|こうたい}.

Common in industries that require 24-hour operations: hospitals, factories, police, firefighting, and transportation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三交替|さんこうたい}{勤務|きんむ}: three-shift system (day/evening/night)
- {二交替|にこうたい}{勤務|きんむ}: two-shift system (day/night)
- {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}{手当|てあて}: shift work allowance
- {交替勤務|こうたいきんむ}のシフト: shift rotation schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シフト{制|せい}: shift system — the loanword version, common in service industries
- {夜勤|やきん}: night shift — one specific shift within a rotation
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}: irregular work hours — covers non-standard schedules more broadly
